changes.title: MoE Pro – Marks of Excellence calculator

previous.changeLog:
• Fixed the percentage on tanks with a low mark (below 20 %): the mod showed, for example, 0.18 % where the game showed 3.60 %
• The forecast is exact far more often. The mod now reads the damage distribution the way the game servers do, cuts the percentage to two decimals instead of rounding it, and works out which day's values the servers are on (they switch some hours after new ones are published). On 181 recorded battles, with the damage the server counted, the forecast is exact to the hundredth in 176 (73 in version 1.4.0); a morning battle, while the servers switch, can still be a few hundredths off
• Chance of the next mark on a tank with few battles: it showed 0 % and "1000+ battles" for the first hundred battles or so. The mod now takes into account that the mark is still filling up
• A tank whose mark is still at 0.00 % after its first battle gets its panels too

current.changeLog:
- Fixed the game closing at start-up on WoT 2.4.1. The old net.openwg.gameface 1.1.6 no longer loads on 2.4.1, and ModsListAPI 1.7.9 then shuts the client down
- The hangar and battle panels show up again: 2.4.1 changed how interface windows are registered, so GUIFlash 0.6.3 could not load. The mod restores compatibility
- Libraries in the archive updated to their 2.4.1 versions: ModsSettingsAPI 1.7.1, ModsListAPI 1.8.0, net.openwg.gameface 1.2.2 (GUIFlash stays 0.6.3). The game no longer restarts on the first start
- If old or broken copies of these libraries are installed, the mod no longer takes the game down: it runs without the settings window and the mods list button
- Forecast, history and settings are unchanged, your saved history stays
- Before installing, delete from mods/2.4.1.0: moe_pro_1.4.1, ModsSettingsAPI 1.7.0, ModsListAPI 1.7.9, net.openwg.gameface 1.1.6

previous.changeLog:
•	Fixed RAR archive extraction that could produce corrupted mod files.
•	Opening Browse Catalog now focuses the search field so you can start typing immediately.
•	Installed Version now uses compatibility colors when its game version matches Latest Version; other versions remain neutral.
•	About now includes a direct link to Stars Mod Installer on WGMods next to Discord.
•	Buttons now clearly say “Install selected mods” and “Uninstall selected mods”.
•	Tooltips explain automatic and manual installation, and warn when mod files may need to be removed by hand.
•	The Auto-install is off warning opens the setting where automatic mod changes can be turned on.
•	Pending changes explain how to apply them, and failed operations offer a shortcut to Diagnostics.
•	An empty My Mods list points you to Browse Catalog; adding mods no longer needs a separate confirmation message.

current.changeLog:
•	Search in Browse Catalog and My Mods now also finds mods by their Uploaded by name.
•	Both mod lists now show recommended mods first and sort titles alphabetically, including while filtering.
•	Catalog update: significantly expanded the range of mods supported for automatic installation. This is delivered through catalog updates independently of application versions.
•	Installing mods now clears the game's persistent data cache when required by their installation instructions.
Updated to work with World of Tanks version 2.4.1.
